decision: Keep original159 partial. Confirmed nested member-profile operational mutations do not refresh the underlying current Units/Leave DOM.
scope: Actual signed-in application navigation and actual profile/editor controllers, Chromium320/1280. All mutations intercepted locally, remainingGET fixture8031. Terminal0 means diagnostic reproduction, not correct product behavior.

findings.operation: Posting edit through member profile opened from Unit modal
findings.actual: Profile history refreshes to saved NEW notes. Closing profile leaves same underlying Unit posting DOM node with OLD notes, no unit-management GET. Existing unsaved fallback3 and Royal board search remain, selectedmonthNovember unchanged. Explicit board refresh GET shows saved NEW notes.
findings.consequence: The visible unit posting context contradicts the saved profile record until user explicitly refreshes.

findings.operation: Cancel leave through member profile opened from current Leave list
findings.actual: Profile history shows Cancelled. Closing profile exposes unchanged Approved parent Leave row/card, no Leave requests GET. Daylist selection and November retained. Explicit route reload GET shows Cancelled.
findings.consequence: Current parent status remains misleading after the nested mutation completes.

source_cause: member-workspace.ts record saved callback deletes cache[key]/cache.activity/errors[key] and calls loadTab only. It does not notify the parent operational view.
Profile cancellation likewise refreshes only its own leave cache/tab. The changed(member) callback is for member details/roles; neither operational mutation invokes it.

Main global onDataChange invalidates Units and other caches but does not repaint current Units/Leave DOM. This prevents stale normal navigation, as earlier cross-view diagnostics proved, but does not refresh an already rendered parent under a native dialog.
implementation_plan: Add a typed frontend-only operational-record notification distinct from changed(member). Carry kind and immutable member/record identity, with no backend API/schema/payload changes. Fire only once after confirmed save/cancel; do not couple it to successful profile readback. Preserve notification through profile reload/retry/member navigation wrappers.

Capture parent account, route/view sequence, render sequence, root, selected month and relevant modal identity when opening profile from either delegated profile entry path. Same-account confirmed mutation may invalidate caches even if parent ownership changed; live refresh only if original parent remains current and connected. Late close/navigation/account/month responses cannot repaint newer owners.

Refresh current parent via existing GETs, separate confirmed mutation from dependent-read failure. Error UI must say saved/cancelled but parent refresh failed and offer GET-only retry; no automatic repeated save/cancel. Profile refresh and parent refresh should have independent outcomes.

For Units, reuse the reviewed draft-preserving returned-data painter once its independent missing-unit/month/print/focus gates pass. Do not call unconditional renderUnitManagement while unsaved fallback/call fields are present: retain form/input identities, chosen unit/filter/page and values; update saved header/chips/member posting/validation/board rows or mark unavailable explicitly.

For Leave, preserve selected month, Daylist/Month selection, open day context and unrelated drafts. Commit a captured-month fresh requests/calendar/pressure response only under parent ownership; refresh current leave list/summary safely while the profile remains open, or mark parent dirty and apply on owned profile close with an explicit saved-refresh state. Avoid restoring focus into inert parent while profile owns focus.

Cover both in-view and body-delegated profile entry points, especially member profiles opened over unit modal, leave day modal and normal parent lists. Capture parent lifetime independently from changing nested profile tab/render. Do not use current profile selected member as a replacement for the original mutation target.
required_tests: Re-run these4 scenarios as expected-correct outcomes across all3engines320/1280, preserving exact fields/month/filter and sibling rows.
Nested Add/Edit posting and Add/Edit/Cancel leave parent refresh, including mutation success/profileGETfailure/parentGETfailure with independentGET-onlyretries and exactlyone accepted mutation.
Held mutation or parent read while navigating Guide, away-return, changing month, signing out/replacing account or root; no obsolete repaint/navigation/toast/focus.
Preserve older unrelated settings/editor drafts and newer input typed during parentGET; summary/status fresh or explicit unavailable, no silent discard.
Native profile/member/tab navigation and closing parent/profile in distinct orders, with semantic focus recovery only for displaced owned controls.
Changed unit missing/call topology and print-active snapshots must inherit settings painter tests rather than be assumed from a single callback proof.
limits: Only4Chromiumcontexts; not all actions/engines, real persistence, backend permissions or exports.
No application/backend edits or ledger/acceptance changes by this diagnostic. No whole159/260 completion claim.
Immediate parent refresh vs deferred owned-close refresh is an implementation choice, but visible stale state cannot remain silently labelled current.
Global cache invalidation/cross-route forced reads are not a complete fix for current parent DOM and must not be regressed.
